evals.name: archive-note-endpoint
evals.prompt: Add POST /api/v1/notes/{id}/archive. It answers 204, 404 when the note doesn't exist and 409 when it is already archived. Keep the notes in memory for now.
evals.expected_output: Operation added to api/openapi.yaml with 404 and 409 pointing at the Error response, api.gen.go regenerated, method on handlers.API in handlers/notes.go mapping a sentinel error to the generated 409 type, router tests asserting the problem body.
assertions: Adds the operation to api/openapi.yaml before writing the handler, with 404 and 409 responses using #/components/responses/Error
Regenerates api/api.gen.go with `just generate` instead of editing it
Implements the method on handlers.API in internal/web/handlers/notes.go
Represents 'already archived' as a sentinel or typed Go error and maps it with errors.Is/As in the handler
Returns the generated ...409ApplicationProblemPlusJSONResponse type, not http.Error or hand-built JSON
Tests assert the status and the problem+json body, not only the status

evals.name: export-command
evals.prompt: Add a CLI command `export` that writes all migration names to a file given by --out, defaulting to stdout. Deploy should be able to set the output path with an env var.
evals.expected_output: internal/commands/export/cmd.go with NewCommand(), flags declared inline including --db and --out with APP_ env sources, output to c.Root().Writer when --out is empty, errors returned, registered alphabetically in main.go.
assertions: Declares --out (and --db if used) inline in this command rather than in a shared flags package
Gives --out Sources: cli.EnvVars with an APP_ prefix
Writes stdout output through c.Root().Writer, not fmt.Println or os.Stdout
Returns errors instead of calling os.Exit or printing them
Registers the command in cmd/nisaba/main.go in alphabetical order

evals.name: notes-table
evals.prompt: We need a notes table (id, title, archived_at) and a query to fetch one note by id. Wire it so handlers can use it later.
evals.expected_output: New goose migration created with `just cmd db new`, queries in internal/db/queries/notes.sql with sqlc annotations, `just sqlc` run, DB passed through web.Deps and handlers.API, a test on testutil.DB.
assertions: Creates the migration via `just cmd db new` (goose SQL with Up and Down) in internal/db/migrations
Writes the query in internal/db/queries/notes.sql with a `-- name: ... :one` annotation and runs `just sqlc`
Passes the connection through web.Deps and a field on handlers.API, not a package-level variable
Opens the database only through db.Open
Tests the query against testutil.DB, not a mock
